title: Alphabet Inc. quarterly report for the period ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: Quarterly Report Pursuant to Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934
summary: Alphabet's Q2 2026 Form 10-Q reports USD 119.796 billion quarterly revenue, USD 40.770 billion operating income, USD 242.474 billion cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities, USD 98.165 billion long-term debt, 12.230 billion common shares outstanding, USD 84.859 billion first-half operating cash flow and USD 80.598 billion first-half capital expenditures. It also documents equity and preferred issuance, antitrust proceedings and potential structural remedies.
